root_cause.text: In the Bluetooth MGMT subsystem, the functions set_ssp_complete() and set_advertising_complete() fail to call mgmt_pending_free() after removing a mgmt_pending_cmd from the pending list, causing a memory leak of the command structure and its associated data.
root_cause.evidence: The patch explicitly adds mgmt_pending_free(cmd) calls in the error path and success path of set_ssp_complete(), and in set_advertising_complete(). The CVE description confirms this omission was introduced by commit 302a1f674c00 which refactored the code but missed freeing the pending command objects.

agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch explicitly adds mgmt_pending_free(cmd) calls in the error path and success path of set_ssp_complete(), and in set_advertising_complete(). The CVE description confirms this omission was introduced by commit 302a1f674c00 which refactored the code but missed freeing the pending command objects.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add missing mgmt_pending_free in error path to prevent memory leak.
intent_record.what: Added call to mgmt_pending_free(cmd) before return in the error path of set_ssp_complete.
intent_record.how: Frees the pending command struct to prevent memory leak when error is handled.

intent_record.intent_summary: Free the pending management command in the SSP setting completion callback to prevent a memory leak.
intent_record.what: Added a call to mgmt_pending_free(cmd) at the end of the set_ssp_complete function, after hci_update_eir_sync(hdev).
intent_record.how: Ensures that the pending management command (cmd) is freed when the SSP setting operation completes, preventing a memory leak and proper cleanup of the command structure.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix memory leak by freeing the pending command in set_advertising_complete.
intent_record.what: Added a call to mgmt_pending_free(cmd) after settings_rsp(cmd, &match) and before new_settings(hdev, match.sk) in set_advertising_complete.
intent_record.how: This ensures that the pending management command object is freed after its usage, preventing a memory leak.

grouping_result.intent: Fix memory leak by freeing the pending command in set_advertising_complete.

consistency_review.core_intent: Fix memory leaks by freeing pending management commands in various completion callbacks.
consistency_review.reason: All three hunks are related to freeing pending management commands to prevent memory leaks in different error or completion paths.

relevance_review.reason: The group's changes directly add missing mgmt_pending_free() calls in the set_ssp_complete() and set_advertising_complete() callbacks, which are exactly the two functions identified in the vulnerability root cause as failing to free the pending command, causing a memory leak.
